extraction_notes: Filed with the State as a Word .docx, so 'pages' and per-row 'page' are null; text read from word/document.xml with python3 -I. Sample dates are printed month/year only (e.g. '09/24'). The document has no coliform table (Table 1) and no violation table; the RTCR statement says no coliform bacteria were detected in 2025 and no Level 1/2 assessments were triggered. Barium row has an apparent unit error (see its notes).
